raw_excerpt: Astro Content Collections (added in astro@2.0.0). 'The best way to manage sets of content in any Astro project: blog posts, product descriptions, character profiles, recipes, or any structured content.' Two types: build-time collections (data saved to storage at build time) and live collections (fetched at runtime). Loaders: glob() (for directories of .md, .mdx, .markdoc, .json, .yaml, .toml) and file() (for single files). Zod schema validation with TypeScript type-safety. astro:content runtime API: getCollection(), getEntry(), render(). Build-time vs live tradeoffs: build-time is best for performance and caching; live is best for real-time data freshness. Migration guides for Hugo, Jekyll, Gatsby, Next.js, VuePress, Docusaurus, Eleventy, etc.
